value.rationale: Neighbor disagreement energy and across-vertex polarization are established distinct social-network objectives. A single natural homogeneous cycle with two competing finite pins admits a complete sharp all-integer, all-strength placement law, including a nonempty interval with opposite recommendations. This is structurally stronger than numerical ranking for one graph and pin strength and identifies a meaningful goal conflict. Deterministic linear model limits external interpretation.
